messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a **Friday or Monday**, giving you a three‑day break (Saturday + Sunday + holiday).  

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) where it was observed | Long‑weekend span |
|-------------|---------|-----------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Mar 31** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories | **Mar 31–Apr 2** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Dec 23** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Mon) |

### Notes & Quick Tips

| Holiday | Observed in 2023? | Why it’s a long weekend |
|---------|-------------------|------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1) | Yes – Sunday | Falls on Sunday; no extra day off. |
| **Canada Day** (Jul 1) | Yes – Saturday | Falls on Saturday; no extra day off. |
| **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11) | Yes – Saturday | Falls on Saturday; no extra day off. |
| **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) | Yes – Tuesday | Falls on Tuesday; no long weekend. |

> **Pro‑tip:** If you’re planning a trip, the best long weekends are the ones that give you a full 3‑day break. For example, the **Family Day** long weekend in Ontario (Feb 18‑20) or the **Christmas** long weekend (Dec 23‑25) are great for a quick getaway.

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown (e.g., province‑specific holidays that don’t create long weekends).
